LESSON: BOOKKEEPING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.1: Bookkeeping

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Bookkeeping. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Bookkeeping
2. Practise Bookkeeping at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Bookkeeping

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Bookkeeping
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Bookkeeping. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Bookkeeping at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Bookkeeping at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Bookkeeping
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Bookkeeping. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Bookkeeping using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Bookkeeping in the examples.
2. Explain Bookkeeping to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bookkeeping.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bookkeeping using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Bookkeeping important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Bookkeeping
2. Practise Bookkeeping at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Bookkeeping

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
